question: In the most frequent type of esophageal atresia:

options.opa: Prenatal ultrasound performed in the third trimester allows diagnosis in 6080% of cases.
options.opb: It is associated in 50% of cases with microgastria and neural tube defects.
options.opc: The distance between the proximal and distal atresic pockets is greater than in the other types of atresia.
options.opd: Gastrostomy should be performed in the first 48 hours of life to allow enteral feeding.
options.ope: The presence of air in the stomach and small intestine on abdominal radiography confirms the existence of a distal fistula.
